intro: Tufty is designed for the way you work. Whether you’re in back-to-back meetings or deep focus mode, it keeps you supported and comfortable—so you can stay productive the stress!

features.title: The right recline support for you
features.text: The 360° swivel and centre tilt mechanism with adjustable tension help you move naturally while providing steady back support—keeping you active without sacrificing comfort.

features.title: Comfort that adapts to every posture
features.text: Sink into the plush cushioning that offers superior comfort for prolonged periods. The soft padding ensures you can sit at ease for long hours, making this chair perfect for both work or leisure.

features.title: Lumbar support that adapts
features.text: The adjustable lumbar pad moulds to your lower back, giving you personalised support and helping you maintain healthy posture.

features.title: Premium materials built to last
features.text: The chrome plated understructure with black nylon castors adds strength, maintaining both durability and elegance—because you should never have to compromise between form and function.

name: Tufty Mid Back Leatherette Ergonomic Office Chair Ash Grey
